newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone coup leaders declare curfew.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone coup leaders declare curfew.

text.p: Soldiers of Sierra Leone's army ousted the civilian government on Sunday and declared a round-the-clock curfew.
Coup spokesman Corporal Gborie in a broadcast on state radio ordered Nigerian soldiers stationed in the West African country not to intervene.
The curfew order appeared to be an attempt to deter looting by soldiers under cover of the confusion.
Gborie said Nigerian troops should surrender their weapons and return to their bases as what was happening was an internal matter.
One official said the Nigerians had tried to prevent the Sierra Leonean soldiers entering certain areas.
Gborie earlier ordered political leaders and army officers with rank from lieutenant colonel to full colonel to report to military headquarters but the curfew appeared to supersede this order.
